# Contribution changelog

Based on upstream adb868c (November update).

- Speech: prevent orphaned Windows fallback helpers after parent exit/crash; serialize startup and close/reap children on restart.
- Build: native dining/desk chair snapping; attached-content cycling and focused surface placement; room names/labels and retained building assistants.
- UI: apartment-unit selection and scenario navigation/announcements, alongside retained panel, picker, event-goal, photography and Social Bunny repairs.
- Scanner, cleaning, away-action and coordinate helpers retain the ported contribution features.
